text: It sounds too simple, so almost no one does this. Choose one meal a day, and make it a rule: chew each bite about 20 times until the food becomes creamy. As a result, the satiety signal comes earlier, stomach function improves, and the urge to “top it off” with something sweet disappears. And after a month you will be able to notice a reduction in your measurements (if there are any) without prohibitions and strict diets), plus more awareness and inner calm - as if the body is thanking you.
